findings.label: Jump-to-bottom entrance animation dropped
findings.detail: The plan specified an entrance animation gated on reduceMotion; the button renders statically with no animation in any case. Accessibility intent is satisfied but the animated affordance is gone. Accept, or add a reduceMotion-gated fade.

findings.label: bright-white absent from ANSER_RGB_TO_KEY
findings.detail: anser emits 255,255,255 for both white and bright-white, so the single triple maps to white only; the bright-white palette value and its ALL_KEYS test coverage are unreachable at runtime. Documented and intentional.
